metadata.A: Same current model + derived Walk; no external IK
metadata.B: Same current model + same derived Walk + pinned FootIK only
metadata.C: Same current model + same derived Walk + one world-vertical root translation; explicit control, not a ready library

rootLiftControl.target: max(0,-minimum of ALL exact skinned weighted Foot/Toe vertices), no constant extra offset
rootLiftControl.update: Immediate rise; fall: target+(previous-target)*exp(-physicalDelta/tau); report cap exceed as failure
rootLiftControl.preserves: All joint local transforms and all XZ vertex positions; does not lock feet

changed: Hips XZ constant and linear cycle displacement removed
